path.label: About me
path.title: How I got here.
path.1.title: It started with servers.
path.1.text: I studied systems administration on the island where I grew up, taking machines and networks apart to see how they work.
path.2.title: Then I wrote the software.
path.2.text: At PwC I built Java and Spring Boot backends for public and private clients, worked in agile teams and learned to explain technical decisions to people who aren't technical.
path.3.title: Now I build where it runs.
path.3.text: At RatedPower, part of Enverus, I build and run the cloud platform behind Power Analyst and other energy products: Kubernetes on AWS, Terraform, observability and AI agents in production.
path.4.title: And I make tools.
path.4.text: Small utilities, guides and AI helpers that save my team time. Most of what I enjoy building starts here.
path.5.title: Next: things of my own.
path.5.text: From November I live in Italy, building products, tools and platforms, and working remotely.
projects.label: Selected work
projects.title: Work I'm proud of
projects.1.title: One Kubernetes platform
projects.1.text: I led the move of the company's applications onto a shared Kubernetes platform on AWS, with every piece of infrastructure defined in Terraform.
projects.2.title: A 50 GB move to PostGIS
projects.2.text: A geospatial database migrated with a safe, phased rollout, so the product kept working at every step.
projects.3.title: Seeing the whole system
projects.3.text: I own monitoring, alerts, dashboards and tracing, so teams know how their services are doing and incidents get fixed at the root.
projects.4.title: AI agents and team tools
projects.4.text: AI agents running in production on Amazon Bedrock, an AI assistant for platform operations and a Python tool that prepares test data on demand.
projects.5.title: Bono Cultural Joven 2023
projects.5.text: The platform behind Spain's €400 culture voucher for everyone turning 18, built for the Ministry of Culture.
projects.6.title: Portik
projects.6.text: A platform to manage real estate properties and everyone involved in them, from the backend to the deployment.
